approval_evidence.quote: REZLIDHIA capsules, for oral use ... Initial U.S. Approval: 2022

launch_evidence.quote: Rigel initiated the commercialization of REZLIDHIA in the U.S. ... recognized net product sales of $0.9 million in the fourth quarter of 2022

notes: Rigel's own REZLIDHIA net product sales from the quarterly release text (one decimal, USD millions). Rigel's ex-U.S. REZLIDHIA sales are partner sales reported as collaboration revenue (Kissei, Dr. Reddy's) and are not in this line. The 2022Q4-2026Q2 series is contiguous; the sum of 2024 and 2025 quarters matches the full-year REZLIDHIA figures printed in the Q4 releases (23.0 and 31.0).
search_log: Bigdata.com search for Rigel REZLIDHIA quarterly net product sales located the earnings releases; every quarter was then taken from the issuer's own EX-99.1 exhibit for that quarter (data.sec.gov submissions, Item 2.02 8-K filings, 2023-01 to 2026-08).

Each quarter read from its own release as current (sentence 'REZLIDHIA net product sales of $X million' or 'were $X million'); comparative prior-year figures in the same sentence were checked for consistency (e.g. the Q1 2026 release's comparative for Q1 2025 is 6.1, matching the Q1 2025 release; the Q4 2025 release's comparative for Q4 2024 is 7.4, matching the Q4 2024 release).
Rigel's product statement-of-operations line 'Product sales, net' includes Gavreto from 2024Q2 and is not a REZLIDHIA line, so it was not used for this product.

Launch: Q4 2022 first sale stated in the 2023-03-07 release ('initiated the commercialization of REZLIDHIA in the U.S.'); FDA approval letter label reads 'Initial U.S. Approval: 2022' (label 215814s000lbl.pdf); openFDA drugsatfda lists the original NDA 215814 approval date 2022-12-01.
Fallbacks not needed: the brand is printed quarterly in the releases from its first sale; no exclusion considered.
